_comment: Kookyar update manifest template. Host this file anywhere reachable (GitHub raw, your CDN, ...) and put its URL in UpdateChecker.UPDATE_JSON_URL. On every release: bump version_code + version_name, set date, translate the changelog lists (fa/en) — the app merges these release notes into Settings → «نسخه و تغییرات» automatically (no new APK needed for note fixes). version_code is compared against the installed BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE.
